description: Use as soon as a caller is found to be outside the automatic-booking service area and agrees to a call from the office. Requires name, phone, city, state, service ZIP, issue_description and confirmed:true. The server rechecks coverage: in_service_area means continue normal booking (no callback is created). For a Massachusetts address it flags the office to call back ASAP (status office_callback_requested); tell the caller the office will call them soon and that they are also welcome to call (617) 479-9911. Outside Massachusetts returns outside_massachusetts and creates nothing. It never books an appointment. Retries within 30 minutes return the same request (duplicate:true).

address.description: Service address: city, two-letter state and five-digit ZIP are required; street and unit are optional.

street.description: Street address, if the caller gave it

zip.description: Five-digit service ZIP; decides coverage and Massachusetts

confirmed.description: True only after the caller agreed to the office calling them back

issue_description.description: What the caller needs, in their words

name.description: Caller full first and last name

phone.description: Callback number. On phone calls the channel supplies the caller ID; confirm it with the caller.

name: request_out_of_area_callback

coverage_verified.description: False when the coverage database could not be read; the office will confirm.

duplicate.description: True when this callback was already requested recently; no second office task was created.

record_id.description: Saved office lead reference, when a callback was requested.

request_id.description: Public operation receipt for support; never a provider customer ID.

title: Request Out-of-Area Office Callback
